---
title: "Headline results"
---

These are the main results for the **adverse (headline)** scenario — a markdown of the
non-marketable loan book calibrated on the EBA 2021 adverse projections — across the
full intensity range and all four channel-mask arms. The single message: **adding the
collateral framework's channels turns fire-sale losses and defaults sharply down, and
most of that reduction comes from private repo, with central-bank credit insuring the
tail.**

```{ojs}
mask = FileAttachment("../data/mask_summary_eba.csv").csv({typed: true})
armName = ({mask_S: "Sales only", mask_SU: "+ Unsecured", mask_SUR: "+ Repo", mask_SURC: "+ CB credit"})
armDomain = ["Sales only", "+ Unsecured", "+ Repo", "+ CB credit"]
maskT = mask.map(d => ({...d, arm_label: armName[d.arm]}))
```

```{ojs}
function armPlot(rows, yfield, ylabel) {
  const solid = rows.filter(d => d.arm_label !== "+ Unsecured")
  const dashed = rows.filter(d => d.arm_label === "+ Unsecured")
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 820, height: 360, grid: true,
    x: {label: "Shock intensity"},
    y: {label: ylabel},
    color: {legend: true, domain: armDomain, label: "Arm"},
    marks: [
      Plot.line(solid, {x: "intensity_num", y: yfield, stroke: "arm_label", marker: "circle"}),
      Plot.line(dashed, {x: "intensity_num", y: yfield, stroke: "arm_label",
                         strokeDasharray: "5,3", marker: "circle"}),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  })
}
```

## System equity loss by arm

Loss on the wipe-to-zero measure, in percent of pre-shock CET1. The gap between "Sales
only" and "+ CB credit" is the framework's total effect. (The **+ Unsecured** arm is
dashed because it coincides with "Sales only" once the unsecured market freezes.)

```{ojs}
armPlot(maskT, "eq_loss_resid_pct", "System equity loss (%)")
```

## Channel marginals

Decomposing that gap into the marginal contribution of each channel: Δ_U (unsecured),
Δ_R (repo), Δ_C (central-bank credit). Repo is the workhorse of moderate stress; the
central-bank marginal is small until the tail.

```{ojs}
intensities = Array.from(new Set(maskT.map(d => d.intensity_num))).sort((a, b) => a - b)
marginals = intensities.flatMap(I => {
  const at = arm => {
    const r = maskT.find(d => d.intensity_num === I && d.arm === arm)
    return r ? r.eq_loss_resid_pct : NaN
  }
  return [
    {intensity: I, channel: "Δ_U (unsecured)", value: at("mask_S") - at("mask_SU")},
    {intensity: I, channel: "Δ_R (repo)",      value: at("mask_SU") - at("mask_SUR")},
    {intensity: I, channel: "Δ_C (CB credit)", value: at("mask_SUR") - at("mask_SURC")}
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 820, height: 360, grid: true,
  x: {label: "Shock intensity"},
  y: {label: "Marginal loss reduction (pp of CET1)"},
  color: {legend: true, label: "Channel"},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(marginals, {x: "intensity", y: "value", stroke: "channel", marker: "circle"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

## Defaults by arm

```{ojs}
armPlot(maskT, "n_defaults", "Number of defaults")
```

## Central-bank collateral pledged

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 820, height: 320, grid: true,
  x: {label: "Shock intensity"}, y: {label: "CB pledged (€bn)"},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(maskT.filter(d => d.arm === "mask_SURC"),
               {x: "intensity_num", y: "cb_pledged_bn", fillOpacity: 0.25}),
    Plot.line(maskT.filter(d => d.arm === "mask_SURC"),
              {x: "intensity_num", y: "cb_pledged_bn", marker: "circle"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

## Where the eligible collateral comes from

Applying the Eurosystem eligibility and haircut schedule to banks' unencumbered
holdings gives the collateral pool banks can pledge. It is dominated by non-marketable
credit claims — the loan book that only the central bank accepts.

```{ojs}
pool = FileAttachment("../data/collateral_pool.csv").csv({typed: true})
Plot.plot({
  width: 760, height: 300, marginLeft: 200, grid: true,
  x: {label: "Share of eligible pool (%)"}, y: {label: null},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(pool, {x: "share_pct", y: "ecb_category", sort: {y: "x", reverse: true}, fill: "#4575b4"}),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Notes
Cross-seed means over ten seeds for the stochastic arms (repo, CB-credit); sales-only
and unsecured are deterministic. Loss is on the wipe-to-zero measure (percent of
pre-shock CET1). All figures are aggregated over the whole 67-bank sample.
:::
